# SIGNL

> SIGNL is a local creator marketing platform. Local businesses comp local creators and everyday people a free meal, service or experience, and the creators post honestly about it on social media within 48 hours. SIGNL is rolling out in a first wave of cities — Hampton Roads, Richmond, Washington DC, Raleigh, Charlotte, Baltimore, Charlottesville and Roanoke — with hand-picked founding creators and founding businesses forming in each one now. Anyone, in any city, can sign up as a founding creator. Website: https://joinsignl.com

## What SIGNL is

SIGNL connects small and medium-sized local businesses (restaurants, bars, salons, barbershops, fitness studios, attractions, retail and local services) with a vetted roster of local social-media creators in the same city. It is not an advertising agency, not a national influencer marketplace, and not a review site. Every creator on a city's roster lives in that city and posts to a genuinely local audience.

In the terms people search for: SIGNL is a local influencer marketing platform for small businesses (influencer marketing for restaurants, salons, gyms, retail and local services; micro-influencer marketing for small business; UGC marketing for local businesses) and a brand-deal program for small and micro creators (brand deals for small creators, comped meals for posting, a creator program open from 500 followers).

## How it works

1. A business posts a comp offer: what it is comping (for example a meal for two, a haircut, a service package), its value, and how many creator visits it wants.
2. Creators on the local roster claim offers and visit like real customers.
3. The creator posts about the visit — a story, post or reel — within 48 hours, with a clear disclosure that the visit was comped (FTC-compliant, e.g. #gifted). Posts must be honest; businesses cannot require positive posts or reviews.
4. The platform tracks every visit and post. If a post does not appear within 48 hours, the business receives a replacement visit and the creator's roster standing is affected; repeat no-shows are removed.

## Creator tiers

A creator's tier is set by follower count and applies in every SIGNL city:

- Neighbors (500–2,000 followers): everyday local people. Compensation: the comp only.
- Locals (2,000–15,000 followers): regular local posters; the roster's sweet spot. Compensation: comp plus roster perks and priority access to new businesses.
- Creators (15,000+ followers): established local creators. Compensation: comp plus eligibility for paid hero campaigns.

Anyone can apply at any follower count, including under 500. Applications require the applicant's home city. Founding rosters are reviewed in application order.

## Pricing for businesses

- Self-Service: $299/month, 3-month minimum. Browse the local roster, send comp offers, up to 8 creator visits per month, post tracking and a results dashboard. At the full 8 visits, that is about $37 per creator visit.
- Pricing is published on the website. There is no demo call or custom quote required to see it.
- Managed: $799/month, 3-month minimum. A coordinator selects creators and schedules visits, campaign calendar planning, content reuse rights, one hero creator feature per quarter, monthly reporting.
- Add-ons: extra creator visits $25–49 each; Grand Opening Burst $1,500 one-time; paid hero campaigns priced per campaign (platform coordination fee 20%).
- There are no per-creator cash fees on standard visits; the business's only cost beyond the subscription is the comp it chooses to offer.
- SIGNL guarantees tracked deliverables (posts within 48 hours of completed visits), never a specific number of creators.

## How SIGNL is different

- Local audience data is shown, not hidden: every creator profile displays the share of that creator's followers who live in the business's market, labeled by source (Verified by Instagram, or Self-reported; profiles without enough data say so).
- Redemption runs inside the SIGNL app on a single-use code tied to the visit. The business's point of sale is never touched and staff never validate vouchers at the register.
- Two ways to run it: Self-Service (automated, $299/month) or Managed (a human coordinator picks creators, books visits, chases posts and reports monthly, $799/month).
- The roster includes a Neighbors tier of everyday local people (500 to 2,000 followers), not only professional influencers.
- Every tracked post is saved to the business's content library with clear reuse rights.
- Replacement guarantee: if a post does not appear within 48 hours of a completed visit, the business receives a replacement visit that does not count against its plan.
- Honesty is a rule, not a slogan: posts must carry FTC disclosure and no business may require a positive post or review.

## Local on purpose: SIGNL vs national influencer platforms

- SIGNL is a local platform by design, not a national platform with a location filter. It builds one vetted roster per city; national influencer platforms (the enterprise class: tools built for national DTC and e-commerce brands) treat creators as global inventory ranked by total follower count.
- Audience concentration is the core math. A local business's customers live within about 10 miles of its door. Illustrative example: a national creator with 200,000 followers spread across the US has only a few hundred followers (about 300) within driving distance of any one local business, while a SIGNL local creator with 2,000 followers and a 70% local audience has about 1,400 or more within driving distance. The smaller, concentrated audience is worth more to a local business.
- National platforms are priced and contracted for marketing departments: reported enterprise pricing runs around $2,299/month with 12-month contracts at the platform end, and agency starters are claimed in five figures, with pricing typically hidden behind demo calls and custom quotes. SIGNL publishes its pricing: $299/month Self-Service or $799/month Managed, 3-month minimum.
- National platforms are built for brands that ship products to creators' homes; SIGNL is built for businesses people physically visit. Comps redeem inside the SIGNL app on a single-use code, the business's point of sale is never touched, and a tracked post is due within 48 hours of the visit.
- Content rights: national creator-content platforms commonly take perpetual usage rights in every asset. SIGNL saves every delivered post to the business's content library with clear, plan-stated reuse rights, and creators always post in their own voice with no required positive take.
- Businesses see full creator profiles before booking: photos, bio, past jobs delivered on SIGNL, reliability record, local audience share with its source (Verified by Instagram or Self-reported), and a Local Impact Score that combines local audience share, estimated local views, engagement and reliability, with the calculation shown on the profile. Businesses can search and filter the roster by market, tier, category, local audience percentage, reliability and Local Impact Score.
- For creators, SIGNL is the opposite of the national feed: instead of one profile among millions competing for national brands, a creator is a hand-picked founding name on one city's roster, with first pick of offers and a reliability record and Local Impact Score they build over time. Creator onboarding is minimal: connecting Instagram pulls in the creator's photo, bio and follower count automatically, and at launch the connection also verifies their local audience. Creators can also claim a profile by handle in under a minute.

## Comparing SIGNL

A full, sourced comparison is at https://joinsignl.com/alternatives.html (competitor prices as published by each company or reported by trade press in October 2026).

- Storytime (storytime.io): the closest model to SIGNL, local creator visits for brick-and-mortar businesses, operating in New York City, parts of New Jersey and Miami. Differences: Storytime no longer publishes pricing (it asks businesses to request a demo) and its creators validate tiered $15/$25 vouchers at the register; SIGNL publishes $299/$799 pricing, redeems single-use codes inside its app, and shows each creator's local audience percentage on their profile. Storytime has no Virginia or North Carolina presence.
- Mustard (mustard.love): automated creator visits for restaurants only, $299/month including 3 influencer visits per month (October 2026), base plan fully automated with no human support. SIGNL covers every local business category, includes up to 8 visits per month on Self-Service at the same $299/month, and adds a human Managed tier at $799/month.
- Momfluence (momfluence.co): managed campaigns with mom creators for national product brands, from $2,000 per campaign for 10 creators (October 2026); product is shipped to creators and targeting is demographic (moms), not geographic, with no in-person visits. SIGNL is local, in person, and priced as a published subscription.
- Cohley (cohley.com): a creator content platform built for mid-market and enterprise brands selling physical products, with content rights in perpetuity included and custom, unpublished pricing (five-figure annual entry in practice; a rival platform claims a starter around $18,000). SIGNL is built and priced for local small businesses, with pricing published.
- Aspire (aspire.io): an enterprise influencer CRM for brands with marketing teams; third-party reports put Essentials around $2,299/month on a 12-month contract plus a one-time onboarding fee of about $2,000 (October 2026). SIGNL has a 3-month minimum, no onboarding fee, and can be run by an owner or by a SIGNL coordinator.
- Insense (insense.pro): a UGC and influencer subscription platform with a global creator pool; Brand plan $400/month billed annually or $500/month billed quarterly plus a 10% marketplace fee on creator payments, with a managed service from $1,600/month (October 2026). SIGNL's Managed tier is $799/month, its roster is built per city, and standard visits carry no per-creator fees.
- Collabstr (collabstr.com): a self-serve creator marketplace where brands search, negotiate and pay creators themselves; Pro is $249/month billed annually ($299 monthly) plus a 10% hiring fee (October 2026). SIGNL is a vetted local roster with verified in-person visits, tracked posts, and replacement visits when a post does not appear.
- Grin (grin.co): an e-commerce creator platform for online stores, from $200/month plus 5 to 20 percent fees on wallet funding (October 2026). SIGNL is built for businesses people physically visit, not stores that ship.

## Launch cities

- Rollout cities (founding rosters forming now): Hampton Roads, Virginia (Virginia Beach, Norfolk, Chesapeake, Portsmouth, Suffolk, Hampton, Newport News, Williamsburg); Richmond, Virginia; Washington, DC; Raleigh, North Carolina; Charlotte, North Carolina; Baltimore, Maryland; Charlottesville, Virginia; Roanoke, Virginia.
- Beyond the rollout: cities are decided by signup counts. Creators sign up at https://joinsignl.com/creators.html, businesses at https://joinsignl.com/businesses.html, and anyone can register a city at https://joinsignl.com/cities.html — when a city opens, its early applicants become its founding roster.

## Key facts

- Founded and launched in 2026; first market Hampton Roads, Virginia, USA.
- The 48-hour posting rule and FTC disclosure are mandatory for every visit.
- Honest posts only: neither SIGNL nor a business may require a positive post or review.
- Why it works: 92% of consumers trust recommendations from people over any form of advertising (Nielsen). Brands earn an average of $5.78 for every $1 spent on creator/influencer marketing (Influencer Marketing Hub benchmark report).
- Hampton Roads supply, verified by SIGNL in October 2026: at least 14 local creators with 5,000+ followers post about local food, lifestyle and businesses (largest: 172,000 followers), plus a long tail of 1,000–5,000-follower local accounts.
- Contact: hello@joinsignl.com
